body.en:
Question B-001-010-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Secondary status means amateur use is conditional: amateurs may use the band only while protecting primary users from interference.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Nothing special: all users of a frequency band have equal rights to operate": Equal rights would describe co-primary or equal-status sharing; secondary status is specifically a lower-priority permission.
- sourceIndex 2: "Amateur radio operators are only allowed to use the frequency band during emergencies": Emergency-only operation is not what secondary status means; the band can be used routinely if primary users are protected.
- sourceIndex 3: "Amateur radio operators can only use the band briefly for radio testing and adjustment purposes": Brief testing is too narrow; secondary amateur operation can include normal amateur activity when it does not interfere with primary services.
